table.retrieve:
SELECT
	DepotID=:as_distcode + REPLICATE(' ', 2 - LEN(:as_distcode)),
	ProductID=SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(Max(I.packingdesc))), 1, 9),
	Product=I.Name,
	NetSaleQty=SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'SV' THEN st.qty WHEN 'SR' THEN - (st.qty) ELSE 0 END),
	StockBalQty=SUM(
		CASE WHEN TYPE = 'OP' OR TYPE = 'PV' OR TYPE = 'SR' OR TYPE = 'RV' OR TYPE = 'AI' THEN +1 
		ELSE -1 END * (st.qty + st.bonus) )
FROM
	(SELECT type='OP', icode, qty = sum(qty), bonus = sum(bonus)
	FROM	
		(select pd.icode, 
			qty = sum(isnull(
				case pl.purcatcode 
				when 1 THEN (pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
				when 2 THEN (pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
				else pd.looseqty end, 0)), 
			bonus = sum(isnull(
				case pl.purcatcode 
				when 1 THEN (pd.bonusqty * pd.packunits)
				when 2 THEN (pd.bonusqty * pd.packunits)
				else pd.bonusqty end, 0))
		FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd, item i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
			pl.postdate < :ar_startdate AND
			pd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	pd.icode, qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty), bonus = - sum(pd.bonusqty)
		FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd, item i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
			pl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			pd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty), bonus  = -sum(sd.bonusqty)
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			  sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND sd.Due IS NULL AND
			sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, qty  = sum(sd.looseqty), bonus = sum(sd.bonusqty)
		FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
			  sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
		      sl.postdate < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, qty  = -sum(sd.qty), bonus = 0
		FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, qty  = sum(sd.qty), bonus=0
		FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
		      sl.postdate < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.looseqty), bonus=0
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		      sl.posteddate < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, qty = -sum(sd.looseqty), bonus=0
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
		      sl.posteddate < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	d.icode, qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty), bonus=0
		FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d, item i
		WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
		      h.duesatisfydate < :ar_startdate AND
			d.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By d.icode) A
	GROUP BY icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PV', pd.icode, qty = sum(pd.looseqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits), 
		bonus = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN pd.bonusqty * pd.packunits
			when 2 THEN pd.bonusqty * pd.packunits
			else pd.bonusqty
			end, 0))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd, item i
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
		pl.postdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND
		pd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PR', pd.icode, qty = sum(pd.looseqty), bonus = sum(pd.bonusqty)
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd, item i
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
	      pl.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND
		pd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SV', sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.looseqty), bonus = sum(sd.bonusqty)
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
		sl.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode and 
		sd.saleprice <> 0 AND
		i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SVFOC', sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.looseqty), bonus = sum(sd.bonusqty)
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
		sl.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND sd.saleprice=0 AND
		sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SR', sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.looseqty), bonus = sum(sd.bonusqty)
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
	      sl.postdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='IV', sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.qty), bonus = 0
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
		sl.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='DS', d.icode, qty = sum(d.duesatisfyqty), bonus = 0
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d, item i
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode = d.duesatisfycode AND
		h.duesatisfydate >= :ar_startdate and h.duesatisfydate <= :ar_enddate AND
		d.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By d.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='RV', sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.qty), bonus = 0
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
		sl.postdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AI', sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.looseqty), bonus = 0
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		sl.posteddate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AD', sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.looseqty), bonus = 0
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
		sl.posteddate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By sd.icode
	/*UNION ALL
	SELECT type='OP', icode, batch=SPACE(10), expiry=getdate(),qty = 0, bonus = 0
	FROM ITEM 
	WHERE ManfCode IN (:manfcode)*/) St, 
	Item i
WHERE st.icode = i.icode
GROUP BY i.icode, i.name, i.customicode
ORDER BY i.customicode
